report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; metrics show /v1/checkout 200s and zero 502s, and traces show successful order/inventory/payment/postgres spans. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects healthy latency, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual error or elevated latency (e.g., non-200 responses, timeouts, or p95 regression) on /v1/checkout
Logs or dependency metrics showing failures in order, inventory, payment, redis, or postgres
Baseline latency distribution to determine whether observed 63-172ms is anomalous
